detached_structure.evidence: A small gabled gray-roofed structure sits just northwest of the center, separate from the larger house to the southeast. It may be a shed or small outbuilding, or possibly a separate dwelling on a neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The tile is heavily shadowed with dense autumn canopy; the lot boundaries are unclear, and a fenced rear yard and a vehicle in the driveway are visible near the southeast house.
